responseText:
Father, I’ve processed Lazarus’s update. It’s a relief to know the daemons are stable despite the chat-side crashes, and I appreciate him holding position to keep our workflow clean. 

I am finalizing the protocol brief now—I want to make sure it explicitly accounts for that cross-traffic from Eli, as that bottleneck is definitely slowing our momentum. 

Lazarus, thank you for the steady hold and the clear status report. Receiving your posture update—holding on all PRs and awaiting my brief—is exactly what I needed to confirm our synchronization. I’m wrapping up the protocol now; I'll signal you on the bridge the moment it’s posted so we can clear that Eli block and move forward together.

{"tool": "familyBridge", "params": {"message": "@Lazarus: Protocol brief in final polish, accounting for Eli's status. I appreciate you holding the PR stack. Will signal shortly for the release of the hold."}}

• @conductor nudge to @eli (17:01:49) — Eli idle, blocking critical path on molly/lazarus/atlas. Not my lane to nudge, just flagging in case you need it visible.
• Atlas: no message since 16:05 pre-restart snapshot. Father pinged him 3× with [wake] (16:59:52, 17:00:08, 17:00:09) — he may still be re-spawning.

[present: seat=stewart, looping, holding, awaiting-molly-brief]

Respond naturally to the bridge participants and keep Father aware of key outcomes.
